# Posterizarr

> Automated artwork scraping, dynamic overlay generation, and media server synchronization for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby.

## LLM Architecture Guide
- [LLM Master Architecture Guide](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/llms/): Comprehensive system architecture, data models, Docker lifecycle, and conventions for AI agents.

## Core Documentation
- [Configuration Guide](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/configuration/): Complete schema documentation for config.json.
- [Search Order & Provider Priority](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/searchorder/): Detailed logic for Simple, Global, and PerMediaType provider strategies.
- [API Endpoints Reference](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/endpoints/): Full documentation of FastAPI REST endpoints and WebSockets.
- [Agregarr Integration](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/agregarrintegration/): Setup and webhook callback specifications.
- [PowerShell Automation Core](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/powershell_scripts/): Modules, functions, and command pipelines.
- [Backend Python](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/backend_python/): Backend architecture and database management.
- [Frontend Components](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/frontend_components/): React and UI components reference.
- [Action Center Guide](https://fscorrupt.github.io/posterizarr/action_center/): Artwork resolution and fallback workflows.
